steps.name: ${_NODE_IMAGE}
args: import{mkdirSync,writeFileSync}from'node:fs';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';import{execFileSync}from'node:child_process';const sha='${_SOURCE_SHA}',expected='${_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256}';if(!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(sha)||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(expected))throw Error('Require pinned source SHA and archive checksum');const r=await fetch('https://codeload.github.com/pauloafonsofraga/AVDesigner/tar.gz/'+sha);if(!r.ok)throw Error('Source download failed');const bytes=Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());if(createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex')!==expected)throw Error('Source checksum mismatch');writeFileSync('/workspace/source.tar.gz',bytes);mkdirSync('/workspace/source');execFileSync('tar',['-xzf','/workspace/source.tar.gz','--strip-components=1','-C','/workspace/source']);execFileSync(process.execPath,['/workspace/source/scripts/prepare-cloud-build-context.mjs','/workspace/source','/workspace/context','/workspace/validation-manifest.json'],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Verified source '+sha);

steps.name: ${_DOCKER_BUILDER}
args: image='wirenexus-staging-validation:${_SOURCE_SHA}'; test "$$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}}' "$$image")" = linux/amd64; test "$$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Config.User}}' "$$image")" = node; test "$$(docker image inspect --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' "$$image")" = '["node","scripts/start-cloud-run.mjs"]'; docker image inspect --format '{{json .Config.ExposedPorts}}' "$$image" | grep -q '"8080/tcp"'; docker image inspect --format 'Validated image ID: {{.Id}}' "$$image"; docker run --rm --network=none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/source/scripts/cloud-run-image-smoke.mjs,dst=/app/scripts/cloud-run-image-smoke.mjs,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/validation-manifest.json,dst=/validation-manifest.json,readonly "$$image" node scripts/cloud-run-image-smoke.mjs --require-linux-amd64 --port=8080 --manifest=/validation-manifest.json
